main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n decimal strings, scales each by 10^9, marks values not divisible by 100000 as -1, enumerates divisors of 100000000, and counts pairs whose products are divisible by 100000000." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read a long long integer n from standard input. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Declare loop variables i, j, and k, character buffer s, and long long integer array a. RESULT local_variables]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 through n-1, read a decimal string into s, set a[i] to 0 and k to 0; then for each character index j starting at 0 and incrementing by 1 while s[j] is not the null terminator: if s[j] is not '.', set a[i] to 10 * a[i] + (s[j] - '0') and increment k only when k is greater than 0, otherwise set k to 1; after the character loop, if k is 0 set k to 1; then while k is less than 10, multiply a[i] by 10 and increment k. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Set q to 100000. RESULT q]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 through n-1, if a[i] modulo 100000 is greater than 0, set a[i] to -1, otherwise set a[i] to a[i] divided by 100000. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Set q to 100000000, set j to 0, and build array b holding all divisors of q in ascending order with count j: first for i from 1 while i * i <= q, if q modulo i is 0, store i in b[j] and increment j; after that loop, decrement i; then if i * i equals q, decrement i again; then while i is greater than 0, if q modulo i is 0, store q / i in b[j] and increment j. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 through j-1, set c[i] to 0. RESULT c]
            [COMMAND Set ans to 0. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 through n-1: if a[i] is negative, continue to the next iteration; otherwise compute l as q divided by the greatest common divisor of q and a[i]; set min to -1 and max to j; while max - min is greater than 1, set mid to (max + min) / 2 and if b[mid] is less than l set min to mid, otherwise set max to mid; add c[max] to ans; then for each k from 0 through j-1, if a[i] modulo b[k] equals 0, increment c[k]. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Print ans as a long long integer followed by a newline. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main. RESULT return_code]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
